notes.companyServiceLines: service_line only exists on DEAL, not COMPANY. Company-level service_lines here are derived by grouping this pull's open_deals.json + closed_deals.json by company_name and collecting distinct service_line values -- this only covers deals in this pull's horizon (open + FY27 closed), so most companies' full service-line history (pre-FY27) is not reflected. 194 of 749 companies (25.9%) have at least one service line from this horizon; treat companies.json's service_lines as a lower bound, not a complete picture.
notes.currentVsPrevious: HubSpot has no single 'Current/Previous client' status field. This pull's company filter (lifecyclestage = customer OR previous_client_date_added__c populated) is a proxy matching the prior pull's methodology; account_sales_tier__c is a richer but separately-maintained classification that can disagree with this status on the same company.
notes.driftVsPriorPull: Counts drift naturally pull-to-pull as deals/companies move through the CRM (prior 2026-08-04 pull: 696 open, 546 closed FY27 (202 won/344 lost), 744 companies (187 with service-line data)). This pull's small increases (694 open, 614 closed, 749 companies) are expected, not a sign of a broken pull.
